title: The Shepherd of Hermas and the last four letters of Ignatius
summary: All seven letters Ignatius of Antioch wrote on his way to die in Rome are now on the site: this release adds his letters to the churches of Magnesia, Tralles and Philadelphia, and his personal letter to Polycarp, each with a Plain English Translation from the Greek, study notes and manuscript differences. It also adds the Shepherd of Hermas, the longest of the writings called the Apostolic Fathers: a Roman book of visions, commandments and parables about a second chance to repent; its last chapters survive almost only in Latin, so the translation follows the Latin there. Two new topic pages come with them: Hermas, and Penance: Forgiveness after Baptism.
